section.text: Spawns an orb that circles you.
wants to scan DNA she has never seen before.
How many creatures can [item=alter_gem]s be used on? I feel like their full potential is untapped.
I would like to experiment with using an [item=alter_gem] on a creature that doesn’t normally react with them…[pause=1] like a [item=cat].
Why do [item=alter_gem]s work on some creatures and not others? Is there a way to force it to work?
Hand me that jar. And that vial. I will not give up until this works!
.[pause=1].[pause=1].[pause=1]. What happened? Did it work? The [item=cat] and [item=alter_gem] are gone… but what is that strange creature…?
I aM gLItcH Cat![pause=2] I liKe CaTs.[pause=2] tHiS GaME hAs nOt eNough Cats![pause=2] hElp adD CaTs to gAmE!
IF you NEEd tO FInD ME, uSe [item=cheeseburger default=CHEeseBurGer].
I…[pause=2] am having a creative block. I haven’t spliced a truly new creature in months!
Maybe what I need is to see something completely different from the genes I have already scanned!
This is it! It’s similar to the enemy, but has been changed in strange, almost magical ways. I must experiment immediately!
I already added a new form for you to try out. I think you’ll like it!
You can only have 8 orbs at a time!
